title: Saved meal
description: A named meal the person saved for one-tap logging. Web app storage: localStorage goa:meals and db doc state/meals as {list:[SavedMeal,...]}. Newest first (unshift), at most 12 (older ones are dropped). Logging it copies the rows into the day's food log as a new meal number. 'Recent meals' (last 21 days, grouped by sig) are derived from day logs and not stored.

name.description: Name the person gave it, e.g. 'Usual breakfast'.

sig.description: Signature: the short labels of the rows joined by ' + '. Used to hide recent meals that match a saved one. Derived; can be recomputed from rows.

rows.description: Snapshot of the food rows (rowCopy). meal is not stored here; it is assigned when logged.

src.description: Copied from the source row; 'you' when it had none. Rows with no numbers or pending are never saved.

raw.description: Original typed text, or the label when there was none.
